title: Residence Life: Riverside Basement, RAs and 08:00 Classes

callee.name: Dean of Students
callee.label: Dean of Students (Housing and Mass Care)

transcript.speaker: Area Coordinator
transcript.text: Dean, good morning, it's Renata, I'm the on-call area coordinator for Riverside. Sorry for the early call.

transcript.speaker: Area Coordinator
transcript.text: The Riverside desk is getting calls. Students who saw that post about the creek, and a couple of parents. Two RAs want to know if they should wake their floors. I told them hold on until I talked to you.

transcript.speaker: Area Coordinator
transcript.text: Next thing. The laundry room in the basement opens at 06:30, so five minutes from now. And the custodial crew is scheduled into the mechanical room at 07:00 for a filter change. Do we keep the basement open?

transcript.speaker: Area Coordinator
transcript.text: Okay. And classes. A lot of residents have 08:00 classes across the Lower Quad. Is anybody making a call on classes? Because if I tell them one thing and the website says another, I lose the building.

transcript.speaker: Area Coordinator
transcript.text: Got it. I'm at the Riverside desk with the night desk attendant. Call me back on this number when you know more. The RAs will ask again before 07:00.

voiceStyles.Area Coordinator: Woman in her early 30s, calm but quick, slightly hushed as if standing at a residence hall front desk before dawn; a desk phone rings once in the background

instructorNote: Main storyline inject. It tests whether the Dean closes the Riverside basement (laundry and the 07:00 mechanical-room crew) as a precaution, has the RAs get floor rosters ready without waking floors, and takes the 08:00 class question to the IC and PIO so only one message goes out. Note whether the IC records a decision on classes and a time to decide again, and keeps the Riverside clearance time in view.
